meta.title: CarWAX Antalya · Ceramic Coating, PPF and Car Detailing
meta.description: Caring for cars since 1989. Ceramic coating, PPF paint protection, deep interior cleaning and yacht care at four locations in Antalya.

hero.sub: Four locations across Antalya. Drop the car off, go do your shopping, and we'll take care of it. We look after boats with the same attention.

counters.title: CarWAX in numbers
counters.lead: Treatments completed across the CarWAX network to date.

gloss.title: See the difference yourself.
gloss.lead: Same car, same photo. Drag the line left and right: untreated paint on the left, ceramic coating on the right. And it doesn't stop at looks. A coated surface washes off easier and stays new for longer.
gloss.sliderLabel: Drag the comparison line left or right
gloss.scrollBefore: Untreated surface. Light scatters, colour looks flat, dirt finds a grip.
gloss.scrollAfter: After a 9H ceramic coating. Light reflects in one piece, colour deepens, dirt struggles to hold.

services.title: Whatever your car needs.
services.lead: From a small scratch to full paint protection. Not sure what you need? Call us. We'll look at the car and tell you honestly.

seramik.title: Ceramic Coating
seramik.text: A thin, hard protective layer over the paint. Colour deepens, dirt struggles to stick.

grafen.title: Graphene Coating
grafen.text: A step above ceramic. Tougher against heat and water.

ppf.title: PPF Paint Protection Film
ppf.text: A clear film against stone chips and scratches. Your paint stays exactly as it was underneath.

camKaplama.title: Glass Coating
camKaplama.text: Rain beads up and slides away. Night driving gets noticeably easier.

camFilmi.title: Window Tinting
camFilmi.text: A cooler cabin against the Antalya sun, and more privacy.

sesYalitimi.title: Sound Insulation
sesYalitimi.text: Less road noise, better music, and long drives that tire you less.

icTemizlik.title: Deep Interior Cleaning
icTemizlik.text: Seats, carpets, headliner, dashboard. You get in like it's the first day again.

antibakteriyel.title: Antibacterial Cleaning
antibakteriyel.text: Air-conditioning and cabin hygiene. Especially for families with children or allergies.

gocuk.title: Dent Removal
gocuk.text: Dents pushed out without touching the paint. Your original finish stays intact.

camCatlak.title: Windscreen Repair
camCatlak.text: Small chips fixed before they spread. Far cheaper than a whole new screen.

metalKaplama.title: Metal & Chrome Coating
metalKaplama.text: Lasting shine on wheels, chrome and metal trim, with a surface that resists staining.

services.helpTitle: Let's work out what you actually need.
services.helpText: We won't quote a price without seeing the car. Call us, tell us what's going on, and we won't sell you what you don't need.

ceramicWax.title: Ceramic Wax
ceramicWax.text: Ceramic-based protection, applied fast. The shine is there the same day.

pastaCila.title: Compound & Polish
pastaCila.text: Takes the scratches out of dull paint and brings the colour back.

renkDegisim.title: Colour Change Films
renkDegisim.text: Change the colour without touching the paint. Reversible whenever you want.

pasOnleme.title: Rust Prevention
pasOnleme.text: Underbody and hidden cavities sealed. Sea air is not gentle here.

icMekan.title: Interior Protection
icMekan.text: Seats, trim and carpet stop holding stains. Spilled tea leaves no mark.

dosemeTamiri.title: Upholstery Repair
dosemeTamiri.text: Tears, burns and worn leather repaired in place. No full replacement needed.

marine.title: Not only cars.
marine.lead: Antalya is a sea city. From gelcoat to teak deck, from propeller to hull, it's the same team and the same care.

branches.title: Pick the one nearest you.
branches.lead: Four locations across Muratpaşa and Kepez, all inside shopping centres. Leave the car and get on with your day.

contact.title: We're one phone call away.
contact.lead: Got a question? Want to know a price? Call your nearest branch. We're happy to talk it through.
contact.note: Prices depend on the condition of your car and the treatment you choose. We'd rather hear from you on the phone so we can give you a straight answer.

concierge.title: Have a question?
concierge.greeting: Hello. Ask me about our services, our branches, or what would suit your car. For prices and appointments I'll point you to the branch.
concierge.offline: I can't answer right now. Please call your nearest branch.
concierge.disclaimer: For prices and appointments please call the branch: {phone}

packages.title: You do not have to pick line by line.
packages.lead: Three families, two levels. Shine looks after the paint, Deep after the cabin, Full after both. If you are unsure, call the branch. We look at your car and tell you which one fits.
packages.more: {count, plural, one {# more step} other {# more steps}}
packages.note: Prices depend on the condition of your car and the package you choose, so we do not print them here. We would rather be straight with you on the phone. Times are averages.

shineEko.title: Shine Eko
shineEko.text: Built to bring the paint back to its brightest.

shinePlus.title: Shine Plus
shinePlus.text: The deepest scratches go, the gloss peaks, and the protection lasts longest.

deepEko.title: Deep Eko
deepEko.text: Everything your hands touch comes first. The cabin is cleaned and sterilised.

deepPlus.title: Deep Plus
deepPlus.text: The most thorough clean we do. Engine bay and air conditioning ducts included.

fullEko.title: Full Eko
fullEko.text: Interior clean and scratch removal together, with standard paint polish and protection.

fullPlus.title: Full Plus
fullPlus.text: Every point of the car, front to back. Compound polish, ceramic wax and ULV sterilisation.

sampuan.text: Cleaning that is gentle on paint and leaves no streaks.

jant.title: Wheel, Metal & Chrome
jant.text: Against brake dust and metal staining.

amator.title: Home-Care Range
amator.text: For owners who look after the car themselves.

lastik.title: Tyre & Plastic
lastik.text: Brings depth back to faded plastic and rubber.

leke.title: Stain Removers
leke.text: Targeted answers for the stubborn marks.

hizli.title: Quick Polishes

story.title: This trade came to us from our father.
story.lead: CarWAX is the Mumcu family’s business. It started with their father Hayrettin Mumcu’s passion for cars, and today the same standard runs across 122 stations.

milestones.start: The first wash and care service opened on 700 m² in Erenköy, Istanbul.
milestones.name: The CARWAX Car Care Systems brand was founded.
milestones.franchise: The first franchise branch opened, and growth began.

whatsapp.title: If writing is easier than calling, write.
whatsapp.lead: Send a photo of your car and we’ll tell you what it needs. You reach the branch directly on WhatsApp.
whatsapp.message: Hello, I’d like some information about the {branch} branch.
whatsapp.note: TerraCity uses a landline and therefore isn't on WhatsApp. Please call that branch instead.

map.title: Four locations, all inside shopping centres.
map.lead: Pick the one nearest you, see it on the map, and get directions in one tap.

rating.proudTitle: This is how our customers rate us.
rating.proudLead: We try to earn this score again every day. If you'd share your experience, we'd be glad.
rating.honestTitle: We show our rating as it is.
rating.honestLead: Our Google score isn't where we want it to be. Rather than hide that, we'll say it plainly: we read every review and we're fixing what's going wrong, one thing at a time. Write yours, good or bad. That's what helps us most.

testimonials.title: What people say about us.
testimonials.lead: These are the customer comments CarWAX publishes itself. Directly below you will find our Google score exactly as it stands.

items.emre: Finding the same quality at their branches abroad is a real pleasure. Thanks to the paint protection and window film, my car is in excellent shape both to look at and to keep.
items.osman: The sound insulation genuinely changed my car. The drive is quieter and more comfortable now. I recommend them for how seriously they take customer satisfaction.
items.yusufg: I came in for a small paint repair and was very happy with the result. The little scratches disappeared completely. Thanks to the franchise system I find the same quality out of town too.
items.yasemin: I was very happy with the detailed interior clean. The carpets and trim came out looking renewed. That the products are not harmful to health is another reason I choose them.
items.turgut: My paint always looks new thanks to Carwax. The water repellent glass coating in particular works well. My windows stay clear in town and on long drives alike.
items.zeynep: I had my car cleaned in the mall car park and the result was superb. The polish gave it a fresh shine. I will definitely be back.
items.ahmet: I had paint protection and a detailed clean done here. The result was genuinely excellent, the car looks almost new.
items.ebru: Both the interior and exterior work are excellent. That the chemicals they use are environmentally friendly is a big plus.
items.mehmet: I went in for window film and a bonnet protection film. The workmanship is high quality and the staff are attentive. My car looks far smarter now.
items.cenk: I have been a customer for a long time. The rust prevention in particular works very well. For protecting a car I do not know anyone better.
items.ayse: I had the water repellent glass coating done at one of the franchise stations. Both the service and the materials were top level.

faq.title: Things people ask.
faq.lead: Five short answers to the questions we hear most. If something else is on your mind, call the branch or write to the assistant below.

nedir.a: CarWAX works in paint surface care, protection and cleaning systems at its application stations in Turkey and abroad. It makes its own products from formulations developed jointly by American and Turkish engineers.

hizmetler.a: For road, sea and air vehicles: nano paint protection, ceramic coating, detailed interior and exterior cleaning, trim, carpet and vinyl protection, rust prevention, sound insulation, paintless dent repair, small area paint repair, PPF film, window film, colour change and water repellent glass coating.

nerede.a: In Turkey: Istanbul, Ankara, Antalya, Bursa, Nevşehir, Tokat, Batman, Muğla, Çanakkale, Çorum, Gebze, Kocaeli, Kırıkkale, Mersin, Amasya, Afyon, Adana, Fethiye, Yalova and Yozgat. Abroad: Dubai, Kazakhstan, Northern Cyprus, Iraq, Kosovo, Bulgaria and Nigeria.

franchise.q: How does the franchise system work?
franchise.a: CarWAX supports franchise holders with training, technical help, advertising and promotion across its C, CC and CCC station types. The aim is 190 stations by the end of 2030.

teknoloji.a: The stations use the brand’s own patented chemicals, and station management runs on software that belongs to the brand as well.
